name: Routine Runner
description: Run your morning and evening routines step by step with a timer and a voice that guides you.
prompt: A routine runner with morning and evening routines made of timed steps I can edit, a full screen mode that counts down each step, says the next step out loud, vibrates and celebrates at the end.
author: gonzaroman
